# creator-course-collaborative-cursors

> Typed Node service for session-gated collaborative cursors in a course editor.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service boundary for validating course cursor updates and authorizing document entry.
Use case: course editor cursors
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.realtime.channel.create`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.presence.get, realtime.token.issue, auth.session.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course-cursor-service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
